_comment: Recorded results, with provenance for every number. Rows marked source 'kaggle-notebook' were produced by patchcore-base.ipynb before the module refactor and are transcribed from the project log / surviving cell outputs. Rows marked 'kaggle-run-v2' were measured by this code on Kaggle (results/runs/ae_v3_kaggle.json, log at results/runs/kaggle_v2.log). Runs named in promoted_runs are curated into rows below and are not re-emitted automatically by scripts/make_results_table.py. Rows marked 'local-run' were measured by this code on the local CPU (results/runs/ae_v3_holdout30.json, training log beside it).
dataset: MVTec AD, category 'bottle' (209 train / 83 test images, 63 defective)

rows.label: PatchCore (baseline, Anomalib)
rows.provenance: Anomalib PatchCore run; defect_detection_log.md sec. 'PatchCore baseline'. Reproduce with scripts/patchcore_baseline.py.
rows.note: Reference point, not part of this model. Included to size the gap.

rows.label: Autoencoder v1 - large bottleneck (256x16x16)
rows.provenance: defect_detection_log.md sec. v1. Superseded; no checkpoint retained.
rows.note: Identity shortcut: the 65,536-value latent let the model copy its input through, so defects survived into the reconstruction.

rows.label: Autoencoder v2 - tight bottleneck (64x8x8) + denoising
rows.provenance: defect_detection_log.md sec. v2. A later re-run of the same config (notebook cell 14) gave 0.874 / 0.743 clean and 0.511 / 0.556 lighting - see the run-to-run variance note in the README.
rows.note: Shortcut closed. image-AUROC >> pixel-AUROC: the model knew whether, not where.

rows.label: Autoencoder v3 - local-SSIM anomaly map
rows.provenance: defect_detection_log.md sec. v3, confirmed by the surviving output of notebook cell 17 (0.9373 / 0.8942 clean, 0.5123 / 0.7150 lighting).
rows.note: +15 pixel-AUROC points with no retraining. Lighting image-AUROC at chance is the open bug Fix 2b tried to close.

rows.label: Autoencoder v3 - re-run after the module refactor
rows.provenance: results/runs/ae_v3_kaggle.json. Fresh 80-epoch training run, seed 0, on Kaggle (CPU: the assigned Tesla P100 is sm_60 and the preinstalled torch supports sm_70+, so the device probe fell back). 1931 s, final loss 0.0643.
rows.note: Reproduces the notebook within run-to-run spread (0.937/0.894 -> 0.937/0.908 clean; 0.512/0.715 -> 0.551/0.720 lighting), which is the evidence that the refactor preserved the numerics. Re-evaluated locally on 2026-10-26 (results/runs/ae_v3_local_repro.json, MVTec bottle fetched file by file from Kaggle, lighting set rebuilt with seed 0): 0.937/0.908 clean, 0.555/0.721 lighting, so the local data and the generalised evaluator reproduce it.

rows.label: Autoencoder v3 + median/MAD image score (REJECTED)
rows.provenance: results/runs/ae_v3_kaggle.json, same checkpoint and same anomaly maps as the row above, scored differently in the same pass.
rows.note: Fix 2b failed. Image-AUROC fell in BOTH conditions: clean 0.937 -> 0.642, lighting 0.551 -> 0.451 (below chance). Dividing by each image's own MAD removes a signal that was real, because an image that reconstructs badly overall is genuinely more likely to be defective, and MAD itself rises with the defect. See README 'Fix 2b: what happened'.

rows.label: Autoencoder v3 - 179-image train, 30 held out
rows.provenance: results/runs/ae_v3_holdout30.json. Fresh 80-epoch run, seed 0, on 179 of the 209 train images (30 held out for calibration, recorded in the checkpoint), local CPU, 1127 s.
rows.note: Baseline for Fix 2c: the raw score on the checkpoint the calibration needs. Its own median/MAD score is consistent with Fix 2b's rejection (clean 0.607, lighting 0.471). Split by the replayed shadow labels (results/lighting_subsets.json), lighting image-AUROC is 0.269 on the 32 shadowed images (inverted) and 0.731 on the 51 unshadowed: the headline 0.573 averages two failures.

rows.label: Autoencoder v3 + per-pixel z, matched calibration (REJECTED)
rows.provenance: Same run, same anomaly maps as the row above. Clean images against clean held-out normals; lighting images against held-out normals stressed with lighting seed 1 (4 copies each).
rows.note: Fix 2c failed its pre-registered bar (lighting image-AUROC +0.05, clean loss <= 0.02): lighting image-AUROC 0.573 -> 0.569. Clean image-AUROC rose 0.948 -> 0.958, but clean pixel-AUROC fell 0.902 -> 0.869: discounting the rim helps contamination (pixel 0.847 -> 0.963) and hurts breakage (broken_large 0.927 -> 0.800), because bottles break at the rim. See README 'Fix 2c: what happened'.

rows.label: Autoencoder v3 + per-pixel z, clean calibration (REJECTED)
rows.provenance: Same run, same anomaly maps. Lighting images scored against the CLEAN held-out statistics.
rows.note: The stricter variant, which assumes nothing about the lighting: worse than raw under lighting (image 0.573 -> 0.511, pixel 0.728 -> 0.597). Clean columns equal the row above by construction.

rows.label: Autoencoder v3 - 179-image train + lighting augmentation (ACCEPTED)
rows.provenance: results/runs/ae_v3_lightaug.json. Same split, seed and 80 epochs as the 179-image row; the only change is the factory-lighting pipeline (seed 2) applied to half the samples, target = the lit image. Local CPU, 1620 s.
rows.note: Experiment 3 arm A passed its pre-registered bar (lighting image >= 0.673, clean image >= 0.928, clean pixel >= 0.882): lighting 0.573 -> 0.802 image, 0.728 -> 0.839 pixel, clean 0.948 -> 0.937 / 0.902 -> 0.898. Shadowed subset 0.269 -> 0.740, unshadowed 0.731 -> 0.838. The shadowed reconstruction that collapsed is intact (results/figures/exp3_lighting_lightaug.png): the lighting failure was representation, not scoring. One seed; trained on the test's transform family with different draws.

rows.label: Autoencoder v3 - 179-image train + lighting augmentation, shadow held out
rows.provenance: results/runs/ae_v3_lightaug_noshadow.json. As the row above without DirectionalShadow in the training pipeline. Local CPU, 1222 s.
rows.note: Experiment 3 arm B, read against A (no pass/fail): unshadowed lighting images 0.957 image-AUROC, but shadowed only 0.457. Robustness to brightness, contrast, gamma and colour does not carry over to a shadow the model never saw. One seed; the shadowed subset has 7 good images, so each one moves its image-AUROC by up to 0.14.
